document_title: Apex Yield Fund - Custom Client Agreement (Doc #8812)
summary_text: Advisor promised guaranteed 18% annual return on private client portfolio without market risk and omitted mandatory past performance disclaimer DISC-09.
officer_notes: Rejected: Violates FINRA-2210. Unapproved return guarantees can trigger immediate SEC sanction. Requires full rewrite removing risk-free claims and inserting DISC-09 disclaimer.

summary_text: Marketing brochure promised limitless astronomical upside without disclosing standard market risk factors or downside probability distributions.
officer_notes: Rejected: Unbalanced marketing violation under FINRA-2210-BAL. Marketing team must add 2-paragraph downside risk summary and font size of risks must equal rewards.

summary_text: Standard wealth management agreement featuring complete DISC-09 and DISC-02 clauses, transparent fee schedules, and no guarantee claims.
officer_notes: Approved without conditions. Follows firm standard legal template ver. 4.2 with all disclosures properly styled and prominent.

summary_text: Newsletter claimed clients could legally eliminate all capital gains taxes using off-shore trust arrangements without citing tax counsel disclaimer.
officer_notes: Rejected: Violates FINRA-TAX-WARN. Financial advisers are not licensed tax attorneys. Must add DISC-12 tax disclaimer and delete 'guaranteed tax-free' phrasing.

summary_text: Document solicited direct investor funds outside firm custodian into an unapproved real estate LLC syndication.
officer_notes: Immediate escalation and rejection. Potential selling away under FINRA-3280. Referred to Chief Compliance Officer.
